data.body: Intent Gate: skipped — CLI_user tag present; intent-aligned assumed. Investigation complete. ROOT_CAUSE: tests/scripts/test-resolve-per-branch-review-base.sh was deleted in commit 816d2b89a1 as 'pre-remediation cleanup' after per-branch-review.yml was deleted, but resolve-per-branch-review-base.sh (the script under test) was NOT deleted. This created a test coverage gap: the 3-stage resolution logic (PR base → SPRINT_SESSION_ID → main + existence validation) has no behavioral tests. Hypothesis test: confirmed (test file absent from filesystem, git log shows deletion, .test-index entry was also removed). Fix: restore the behavioral test file and .test-index entry. testing_mode=RED, complexity=TRIVIAL.
